name: Dr. Jean Shinoda Bolen
notes: Her site prints no email. Contact page: 'This website provides several ways to contact Jean all of which will automatically add you to Jean's email list.' Two forms: /message-jean ('send a personal message to Jean') and /contact-request (speaking engagements or book read/review/endorse; the earlier plan's URL). Recorded /message-jean as the general route; /contact-request also works. Using either also subscribes the sender to her list.
